HP 48 GX WebAssembly

Saturn CPU emulator compiled to WebAssembly · Serial / State / HOME folder are browser builtin

Serial: initialising…
Drop file to send over the wire
Waiting for the calculator…

Drag a .rpl or .hp file onto the calculator to upload it to the HP 48 over the serial wire (put the calculator in receive mode first).

Original (non-WebAssembly) source available on Codeberg.
